ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Full Extent of COVID-19 Relief Fund Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of COVID-19 relief fund fraud, including the Feeding Our Future scheme, and identify potential patterns and connections between entities.
questions: What is the full extent of COVID-19 relief fund fraud?
How are the different schemes connected?
ideas.insight: I believe that there may be a larger network of individuals and organizations involved in COVID-19 relief fund fraud, and that further investigation is needed to uncover the full extent of the scheme.
